description: Calculate delivery cost and optional delivery date estimation for a shipment. Doc 1.2 explains that every Nova Poshta call sends apiKey/modelName/calledMethod/methodProperties, so this helper either forwards your raw InternetDocument payload or builds one from typed fields (CitySender, CityRecipient, ServiceType, CargoType, Cost, Weight, SeatsAmount).

request.description: Raw Nova Poshta price calculation payload (CitySender, CityRecipient, ServiceType, CargoType, Cost, Weight, SeatsAmount).

name: waybill_calculate_cost
